Less scrolling.
More showing up.

Grubr brings Durham’s free-food events together, with the details you need and the original source close by.

Find the useful posts

We find society accounts through SU profiles and linked society websites, then collect accessible posts. Each society has a coverage status. Authorised connections and organiser submissions help fill the gaps.

Check the details

We check captions and available event posters for a clear date, time, place and free-food offer. Unclear or conflicting details go for review before becoming a listing.

Keep things fresh

Sources are checked each evening around 8pm UK time. Started events turn grey. The default view includes the last two weeks, and “All found” keeps the full confirmed history. Entry fees are shown separately from free food, and unknown details stay clearly labelled.
